The image presents two line plots, one for the Easy Training Set and one for the Hard Training Set, illustrating training rewards over steps for different models. 

The x-axis, shared by both plots, is labeled "Steps" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500, with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals of 100.

The y-axis, also shared, is labeled "Training Rewards" and has a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 for the Easy Training Set plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the Hard Training Set plot; tick labels are at intervals of 0.1 for the Easy Training Set and 0.05 for the Hard Training Set, but exact intervals are not clearly discernible.

In the Easy Training Set plot, there are two lines: one in teal, representing Llama-On-Policy-Easy, and one in red, representing Llama-LUFFY-Easy. The teal line starts at approximately 0.05 and increases to around 0.35 over the first 200 steps, then stabilizes with minor fluctuations. The red line starts at approximately 0.05 and increases to around 0.35 over the first 200 steps, then stabilizes with minor fluctuations, similar to the teal line but with slightly more variation.

In the Hard Training Set plot, there are also two lines: one in teal, representing Llama-On-Policy-Hard, and one in red, representing Llama-LUFFY-Hard. The teal line starts at approximately 0.01 and decreases to around 0.005 within the first 50 steps, then remains relatively stable near 0.005 with minor fluctuations. The red line starts at 0.0, increases to around 0.15 over the first 250 steps, then fluctuates between 0.1 and 0.18 for the remaining steps.
